name: Optimize bt_json benchmark aggregate in Braintrust SDK

description: Baseline bt_json benchmark command failed; need to debug benchmark invocation/path handling before starting optimization loop.
Second baseline attempt also failed; mktemp pre-created the output path and pyperf requires a non-existent JSON destination.
Established the first successful bt_json benchmark baseline using the existing benchmark suite aggregate across all 11 cases.
Move primitive scalar and float fast paths to the top of _to_bt_safe so deep-copy traversal avoids logger imports and pydantic/dataclass probing for the overwhelmingly common leaf values.
Inline primitive scalar handling inside bt_safe_deep_copy and iterate mappings with .items() so recursive traversal avoids calling _to_bt_safe for common leaf values and avoids extra dict lookups.
